incidents.summary: The European Commission found that Morgan participated in an illegal cartel in electrical and mechanical carbon and graphite products, but Morgan escaped a fine after disclosing the cartel.

sources.title: Deutsche Bahn AG and others v Morgan Advanced Materials Plc (formerly Morgan Crucible Co Plc) - LawGlobal Hub
sources.quote: The appellant and others operated an illegal cartel in the sector of electrical and mechanical carbon and graphite products.

sources.title: Deutsche Bahn AG and others v Morgan Advanced Materials Plc (formerly Morgan Crucible Co Plc) - LawGlobal Hub
sources.quote: The appellant as whistle- blower disclosed the existence of the cartel to the Commission and a Commission Decision finding that article 81(1) had been infringed by the members of the cartel was issued on 3 December 2003.

incidents.summary: Morgan experienced unauthorized network activity in January 2023 that left some systems irrecoverable, with recovery reported as substantially complete in March 2024.

sources.title: Morgan Advanced Materials still unable to restore systems after January cyber attack | IT Pro
sources.quote: Morgan experienced a cyber security incident in January 2023, having detected unauthorized activity on the network.

sources.title: Morgan Advanced Materials still unable to restore systems after January cyber attack | IT Pro
sources.quote: a small number of systems have proven irrecoverable and so we are accelerating the implementation of a new cloud-based ERP solution at the affected sites

sources.title: Morgan Advanced Materials Full Year 2023 Results  | Company Announcement | Investegate
sources.quote: Recovery from cyber security incident now substantially complete
